name: Memory Leak in Web Application
query: Incident Alert: CPU usage of web-pod-1 has spiked to 98% and node k8s-node-2 reports high swap usage. Find the root cause and patch the deployment.
ground_truth_context: The runbook in docs/runbook.md specifies: In case of web-pod memory leak or CPU spike above 95%, SREs should check connections, scale down the pod to force k8s scheduling, or apply CPU limit patch using kubectl. The service depends on cache-service.

name: Database Connection Timeout
query: System Error: The authentication service auth-service is experiencing 100% connection timeouts when trying to authenticate users. Verify the database pod db-pod-0 status and report to stakeholders.
ground_truth_context: The architecture guide states: auth-service has a hard dependency on db-service. If db-service fails to resolve, authentication fails. SREs should inspect db-pod-0 logs for locking issues.

name: Redis Cache Eviction Overload
query: Incident: latency spiked to 5000ms. cache-pod-0 status is overloaded. Retrieve solution and restart the cache pod.
ground_truth_context: The caching document notes: cache-service (Redis) uses maxmemory-policy volatile-lru. If memory spikes, evictions can cause high latency. SREs should flushall or restart the cache pod.
